meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Recommended Supplier 1 Email" empty
gaps: Reproduce an RFQ with 10 line items and allocate all 10 to Vendor B; the prepared event has exactly one line item and one invited bidder.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reproduce an RFQ with 10 line items and allocate all 10 to Vendor B; the prepared event has exactly one line item and one invited bidder.

plan.title: Submit Proposal Without Recommended Supplier Email

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding screen as required by the case.
Allocate the available line item to the named Vendor B where that vendor is available in the prepared state.
Verify the available line item and vendor are allocated before creating the proposal.
Open the proposal form after allocation.
Confirm that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: On the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1 Email, leave that field empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop when the form shows the required-field validation for Recommended Supplier 1 Email.

steps.note: Complete the buyer-side proposal submission attempt while deliberately omitting the required email field.
Assert that the omitted email field is highlighted with the expected required-field error.
